lines.zh: 我在水底摆着鳍慢慢游
lines.en: I swim slowly along the bottom, fins working.

lines.zh: 五米长的身体转个弯要一会儿
lines.en: Five meters of me takes a while to turn.

lines.zh: 我的肉鳍一下一下划水
lines.en: My fleshy fins stroke the water.

lines.zh: 贴着河底的沙，我往前挪
lines.en: I move forward, close to the sandy bed.
I pass through the weeds, and they part.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴摆得很少，却很有效
lines.en: My tail sweeps seldom, but well.
I swim faster than I look.
The light in deep water is green.

lines.zh: 我伸了伸下颌，吞了一口水
lines.en: I work my jaw and take in water.
I slide over a gap in the rocks.
I circle a sunken log half way.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片上有旧的白斑
lines.en: Old white patches mark my scales.
I drift down along the cliff face.

lines.zh: 水底的声音很小，我都听得见
lines.en: Sounds on the bottom are faint; I hear them all.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，越过一片浅滩
lines.en: I rise and cross a shallow shelf.

lines.zh: 我不着急，水里的时间很慢
lines.en: I am unhurried; time moves slowly in water.

lines.zh: 我的鳍骨一节一节地动
lines.en: The bones of my fins move joint by joint.
I swim out of shadow into the light.

lines.zh: 我停在水底，鳍轻轻摆着
lines.en: I rest on the bottom, fins stirring.
My head is large; my eyes are small.
Water passes beneath my gill covers.
This river is older than me.

lines.zh: 我的近亲在很久以前就少了
lines.en: My kin grew scarce long ago.
I need not surface.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，什么也没咬
lines.en: I open my mouth and bite nothing.
Silt settles on my back.
I prop myself on my fins.

lines.zh: 水底安静得能听见自己的血
lines.en: The bottom is quiet enough to hear my own blood.
I stare ahead, still for a long time.

lines.zh: 有些东西从我上方游过去了
lines.en: Something passed above me.

lines.zh: 我这一身鳞，磨了几十年
lines.en: These scales have worn for decades.
There is deeper water below.
I tilt up to look at you from below the surface.
Your shadow falls on the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，水动了一下
lines.en: I turn slowly, and the water shifts.
You do not look much like a fish.
My mouth moves; I am tasting the water.
Should I rise and have a look?
You stand ashore; I cannot reach.
I have not seen a thing like you.

lines.zh: 我绕着你影子游了一圈
lines.en: I circle your shadow once.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，水面就静了
lines.en: You step back, and the surface stills.
I thrash my tail and retreat far.
That struck my flank.
Blood mixes into the water.
I sink a little and steady.

lines.zh: 我不叫，水里的声音传得远
lines.en: I do not cry out; sound carries far in water.
I turn to guard my gills.
My fins have lost some strength.
A wound like this stays a long time.
I circle once around the wound.
Is this something to eat?
I smell something in the water.
I open my mouth and wait.
I will not snatch; I only come closer.
Your hand is in the water.
I turn and look with one eye.
The splash comes and I pull back.
Having eaten, I sink slowly.
You strike; the water is displaced.
I am much heavier; you cannot move me.

lines.zh: 这一下让水底的沙浮起来
lines.en: That stirred the sand up.
I give half a meter, slowly.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，声音在水中很闷
lines.en: We collide, muffled underwater.
My fin brushes your leg.

lines.zh: 我稳住身子，摆了两下尾
lines.en: I steady myself with two tail beats.
Silt clouds my view.
You retreat ashore; I do not follow.
The water slowly stills again.
There is another on the bottom; I know.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳍几乎相碰
lines.en: We swim side by side, fins nearly touching.
Few of my kind in this river.

lines.zh: 我们绕着沉木转，一圈一圈
lines.en: We circle the sunken log, loop after loop.
I am a little larger than it.
The spawning ground must be deep.

lines.zh: 我们不发声，水替我们传
lines.en: We make no sound; the water carries for us.

lines.zh: 两具大身体在水里很挤
lines.en: Two large bodies crowd the water.
It goes first; I follow.

lines.zh: 这样的伴，几十年才遇到一次
lines.en: A companion like this comes once in decades.
This sinks in water.
I nudge it with my snout.
Too small to taste.
I pin it under a fin.

lines.zh: 水面上的东西，我够不着
lines.en: I cannot reach things on the surface.
It slipped away from my mouth.
I push it into a rock crevice.
One gulp and it is in.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向偏了一点
lines.en: I angle slightly that way.
Not a fish, but it smells.
I rise a little to see better.
This river is my range.
It is smaller than my head.
I wait for it to come near the water.
The current runs my way.
Something has stirred the mud in the water.

lines.zh: 我在水下跟着，只露背鳍
lines.en: I follow underwater, only my dorsal fin showing.

lines.zh: 它沿着岸走，我也沿着岸
lines.en: It walks the bank; I keep to the bank.

lines.zh: 我不浮上来，浮上来就惊到它
lines.en: I stay under; surfacing would startle it.
The water hides my shape.
From this depth, one rush reaches it.

lines.zh: 我的影子在它脚下的水底
lines.en: My shadow lies on the bottom beneath it.
It moves shallow; I wait.

lines.zh: 再走两步，水就到它腰了
lines.en: Two more steps and the water reaches its waist.
I ram with my whole body.
I bite and drag it under.
My jaw carries great force.
The splash bursts and carries far.

lines.zh: 它在水里挣，我咬得更紧
lines.en: It thrashes; I clamp harder.
I whip my head; the water turns with it.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了全身的重量
lines.en: That used my full weight.
I take it deeper.
My fin slaps the water once.

lines.zh: 河底多了一道长长的影子
lines.en: A long shadow joins the riverbed.
I swim up from the deep.

lines.zh: 这条河比我记忆里的窄
lines.en: This river is narrower than I remember.
My fins arrive first, then the rest of me.
I stir the sand up.
The water temperature is just right.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看水面上的光
lines.en: I look up at the light on the surface.

lines.zh: 化石里的那些年，我记不清
lines.en: Those fossil years, I cannot recall.
I come slowly down from upstream.
It is quiet down here; good.
My body displaces the water.

lines.zh: 这一带没有别的大家伙
lines.en: Nothing else large lives here.

lines.zh: 水面上的火烤着我，我往深处沉
lines.en: Fire above bakes me; I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，摔得很重
lines.en: I am thrown onto the bank, hard.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，可这水变了
lines.en: I live in water, but this water has changed.

lines.zh: 爆炸在水里传开，我整个人一颤
lines.en: The blast spreads through the water, and I jolt.
An arrow pierces my flank.

lines.zh: 一股力把水推开了，我压不住
lines.en: A force pushes the water away; I cannot hold.

lines.zh: 水里找不到吃的，我越来越虚
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the water; I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身都麻了
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water; I go numb.
There is not even water.
